Home.title: Find an apartment for the term you need
Home.subtitle: By the night, by the month, or by the year — anywhere in Belarus.

empty.failedDescription: This looks like a temporary glitch. Refresh the page or open search.
empty.noneDescription: As soon as hosts publish a place, it will appear here.

price.title: The final price upfront
price.body: Rent, cleaning, and mandatory fees are shown as one total. What can't be calculated in advance — metered utilities — we flag separately instead of hiding it.

identity.title: You know who you're dealing with
identity.body: Identity verification and the right to rent out a property are separate marks, and we don't mix them. Companies are labeled as companies.

reviews.title: Reviews after real bookings
reviews.body: A review can only be left after a completed booking. Both reviews go live at the same time, so no one can tailor their rating to the other's.

history.title: The history stays with you
history.body: Messages, dates, and terms are kept. If a dispute comes up, both sides have something to point to.

Home.hostBody: Listing is free to publish. A 5% service fee applies only after the booking is complete and both sides have confirmed it. You receive the rental payment directly.
